title: Client snapshot store: one bulk read per project, single-flight refresh, selectors
description: Add Connector.snapshot(project) = {beads, ready, blocked, cursor} (bd-cli: export, then ready, then blocked, serial; new Tauri command get_project_snapshot; backend coalesces concurrent calls per project). Core keeps it in the query cache. While the feed is live, writes patch the cache optimistically (cancelQueries first) and the feed drives refresh: comment-only ops fetch bd comments <id> and patch; other ops run a full snapshot; single-flight (one running + one trailing), 300 ms debounce, next start no sooner than the last refresh took, cancelRefetch false. Feed not live: keep the fallback poll. Selectors: board list filtered like bd list (hide gate etc.), detail with parent from the parent-child edge and edge targets joined by id, knowledge entries, :::question state. No runtime bd show: parity with show is a test. Palette cross-project index keeps its 60 s staleTime.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a bead with a warm snapshot fires 0 bd calls; a feed burst of N events causes at most 2 full refreshes; embedded lock busy under 50% during a burst. Test: vitest for selectors, refresh pacing (fake timers) and parity of snapshot-derived detail vs bd show on a generic fixture; cargo test; e2e: mocked IPC get_project_snapshot + live-updates spec asserting one refresh per burst.

title: Query hygiene: stop redundant export and projects refetches
description: project-knowledge (bd export) has 4 observers with staleTime 4 s..60 s; KnowledgeDetailModal is always mounted with no enabled flag, so every feed event and comment re-runs export. Set staleTime Infinity on project-knowledge (feed invalidates), add enabled to KnowledgeDetailModal, and share one queryOptions object for the three ['projects'] observers (15 s interval each). Keep the fallback list poll when the feed is not live. Ship the caller label (tel0) with this.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a bead with a warm cache fires 0 export calls; one projects poll per interval. Test: pnpm test (queryOptions unit test); e2e: pnpm e2e:browser prefetch spec still green.

title: Per-project bd queue: async Tauri commands via spawn_blocking, spawn timeouts, skip comments at 0
description: Every #[tauri::command] that spawns bd is a sync fn and runs on the main thread (exec_bd uses blocking std::process::Command). Make them async and run the blocking spawn via tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking behind a per-project mutex (one bd process per project at a time): async alone would run bd calls in parallel, which is slower on the embedded lock (4 parallel show 1981 ms vs about 1460 ms serial). Same per-project promise chain in bd.ts. Add a spawn timeout (a POC bd call hung over 120 s). Both backends: skip bd comments when comment_count == 0.
acceptance_criteria: No bd-spawning command runs on the main thread; at most one bd process per project; a hung bd call times out; comments skipped at 0 in bd.ts and desktop.rs. Test: cd src-tauri && cargo test; pnpm test; manual: switch 8 beads rapidly in the desktop app without UI freeze.

Measured cause: sync Tauri commands block the main thread, the embedded bd lock serializes parallel calls (8 parallel show = 4.3 s), and redundant export/projects polling. Plan: quick wins, a connector seam, a client-side snapshot store, auto-selected connectors (bd-cli default, dolt-sql for projects already in server mode, http-snapshot deferred). See spec.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop RUM after vs baseline: bd.call p95 < 1 s; bead-modal INP < 200 ms; opening a bead with a warm snapshot fires 0 bd calls; embedded projects keep working with zero config.

title: Copy prompt for agent: migrate this project to server mode
description: Owner decision (Inbox, 2026-10-30): bd-board only detects server mode and never migrates. For embedded projects, offer a 'Copy prompt' button (pattern from plannotator's Board 'Copy prompt': a pure prompt builder function, a copy hook showing 'Copied' for 2 s, and a test that every command the prompt names exists). The prompt tells an agent how to move THIS project to server mode and why (measured: list 430 -> 89 ms, show ~400 -> 72 ms, 8 parallel shows 4.3 s -> 0.13 s), with options: (1) local shared-server, one bd-managed server for all projects at ~/.beads/shared-server (recommended, not experimental); (2) bucket remote (s3:// with endpoint for Cloudflare R2, gs://), keeping a local replica plus a bd sync timer; (3) remote deployed dolt sql-server (--server-host/port, TLS, credentials via BEADS_DOLT_PASSWORD or the bd credentials file). Prompt is parametrised with project path, prefix and current mode from the probe, and includes the safety steps: stop all bd processes and agents on the project, check backup targets and remotes, export JSONL first, verify counts after. Show it only for embedded projects (probe), e.g. on the project card or the bd status card.
acceptance_criteria: Embedded project shows 'Copy prompt'; server-mode project does not; clipboard holds the prompt for the chosen option. Test: vitest for the prompt builder (per option and project context) and a test that every bd command/flag named in it appears in bd --help for the pinned bd version; pnpm test.

title: dolt-sql connector (Rust): pooled connection, bulk snapshot, HASHOF probe, DOLT_DIFF
description: For projects already in server/shared/proxied mode (detected by the probe). One pooled MySQL connection; snapshot in 3-4 bulk queries; change probe SELECT HASHOF('HEAD') every 1-2 s or on feed event; optional DOLT_DIFF delta (validate hashes before building SQL). Writes keep going through the bd CLI. Ready/blocked stay on bd. Refuse unknown schema_version (fall back to bd-cli). Resolve credentials like bd (BEADS_DOLT_PASSWORD, bd credentials file, TLS env). Gated: build only if RUM after the snapshot store still shows refresh or remote cost (server-mode bd already refreshes in about 270 ms). New Rust dependency (mysql_async or sqlx) needs justification in the PR. POC: full read 6.9 ms vs 95 ms server-mode export; HASHOF probe 0.1 ms vs 84 ms.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot from SQL equals bd export field for field on a generic fixture; change visible within 2 s of a bd write; falls back to bd-cli when the server is down. Test: cargo test against a temp dolt sql-server fixture (skipped when dolt is absent); manual against a server-mode project.

Plus the owner-approved manual embedded->server migration steps and risks (stop all bd processes and agents, backup targets, remotes, who runs the server). Wait for the owner's Inbox decision on migration mode.
acceptance_criteria: README/docs section reviewed by the owner; no private names or paths. Test: pnpm check (prettier).

acceptance_criteria: Embedded projects resolve to bd-cli with no config; a server-mode project resolves to dolt-sql (once that exists); a forced error falls back. Test: vitest + cargo test with bd dolt show --json fixtures (embedded, server, shared, connection failed).
